maria-cs: Heads up — I'm proposing an automated playbook that marks 'onboarding_at_risk' when a new account has <3 product events in the first 7 days AND no CSM touch logged. Sketch below.

maria-cs: Proposed rule (pseudo):
```
if account.age_days <= 7 and product.events_week < 3 and !cs.touch_logged:
  set tag: onboarding_at_risk
  trigger: cs.playbook_onboard_risk
  notify: #customer-success
```

maria-cs: Also want CRM dedupe run weekly before this tag is applied to avoid false positives from merged contacts.

omar-eng: the rule looks fine. how do you want to handle accounts that have short trials (3d)?

maria-cs: good point — add account.trial_length_days <=3 exclusion. i'll add that to the rule.

jess-ops: FYI check the playbook action limits — triggering >200 per hour will hit our rate cap. can we batch notifications or send digests? :thinking_face:

maria-cs: yes let's send a 30m digest to #customer-success and create a high-priority single alert for >500 risk tags in 1h.

sam-cs: Can we also populate renewal_risk if onboarding_at_risk persists after 30 days? Prod asks for an upstream signal for renewals.

maria-cs: Agree. plan: set renewal_risk if onboarding_at_risk && account.age_days >=30 && last_active_days >=21.

omar-eng: Implementation note — we'll add the rule to the playbook engine as a composable predicate. i'll push a draft config.

omar-eng: Draft config snippet (yaml):
```
- id: onboarding_risk_v1
  conditions:
    - age_days: {lte: 7}
    - product.events_week: {lt: 3}
    - cs.touch_logged: {eq: false}
    - trial_length_days: {gt: 3}
  actions:
    - tag: onboarding_at_risk
    - notify: digests#customer-success@30m
```

jess-ops: Nice. Add a dedupe pre-step: run crm.dedupe('weekly') and mark merged_account_ids so tags don't reapply.

maria-cs: I'll file a playbook PR and include onboarding test prompts + eval set. tagging a couple reviewers.

maria-cs: @omar-eng @jess-ops @sam-cs can you take a look by EOD Friday? Want to ship alpha next Monday.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: playbook-engine/service:v1.12 -> staging at 2024-04-11T18:00Z :rocket:

sam-cs: ACK. i'll validate sample cohort in staging and share metrics (false positive rate, tag churn).

jess-ops: i'll scope the digest config and threshold dashboards.

maria-cs: awesome — thanks team. i'll create the PR now and add the eval list.
